arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Upright almost FRONT-facing worker, centered head with both eyes naturally visible. Two short upper-arm edges flank torso. Screen-left tool arm descends to hand holding ONE charcoal hammer at thigh height left of body; other arm hangs close to screen-right side. Feet slightly separated, legs straight. Original frontal proportions authoritative, not the key's right-facing silhouette. Exactly two attached arms. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs. Image3 supplies the EXACT same tool identity: compact rectangular charcoal metal mallet head with charcoal handle, no claw, no brown wood. Rotate that same tool to the source angle and keep the original grip/occlusion. Image3 pose is irrelevant.
